beschreibung: das Elternprofil des Starters trägt `flags=(unconfined)` (früherer Entwurf): in keinem Paket erlaubt
text:
abi <abi/4.0>,
include <tunables/global>

profile werkbank-einschluss /usr/lib/werkbank/werkbank-einschluss flags=(unconfined) {
  include <abstractions/base>
  /usr/lib/werkbank/werkbank-einschluss mr,
  /proc/sys/dev/tty/legacy_tiocsti r,
  /proc/sys/kernel/osrelease r,
  /{**,} r,
  /usr/bin/bwrap Px -> werkbank-einschluss-bwrap,
}

profile werkbank-einschluss-bwrap flags=(attach_disconnected,mediate_deleted) {
  allow capability,
  allow file rwlkm /{**,},
  allow network,
  allow unix,
  allow ptrace,
  allow signal,
  allow userns,
  allow mount,
  allow umount,
  allow pivot_root,
  allow pix /** -> &werkbank-einschluss-bwrap//&werkbank-einschluss-kind,
}

profile werkbank-einschluss-kind flags=(attach_disconnected,mediate_deleted) {
  allow file rwlkm /{**,},
  allow network,
  allow unix,
  allow ptrace,
  allow signal,
  allow userns,
  allow mount,
  allow umount,
  allow pivot_root,
  allow pix /** -> &werkbank-einschluss-kind,
  audit deny capability,
}
